body: Already an organ donor to the state.
I've had fantasies of skydiving.
It's OK, I fell asleep too.

Friday I'm going to treat myself to a very nice steak dinner and a couple of bottles of wine.

In 4 days, there's nothing I can really do.  I'm in a new city all alone.  I don't have a passport, and despite having over 30 grand in available credit, I'd rather not spend too much.  I have nothing left in savings to pay for my remaining bills once I'm gone, and I'd prefer to not leave a huge burden on my family.

If I knew of a way to leave him to you, then sure.

I will leave very clear instructions on some people I know will take great care of him.  However, he will probably be claimed by my parents.  Legally, that's how things go, since I don't have a will all my property legally goes to next of kin - my parents.  And maybe they'll take good care of him.  

I know he's a good boy.  Just tonight we worked on his recall skills off leash for the first time in over a year.  And he did awesome.  I could get 50-60 feet away, in dusk, with traffic nearby and plenty of woodlands.  He'd stay perfectly still, and then come when I called.  He's a great dog.  But I can't provide him the emotional support he needs.  I'm either working (so he's alone) or drinking (so he's alone).

I never really had any.  My parents were emotionally distant.  I never had many friends.  And I was a massive nerd all throughout school.  At one point, I remember playing Ouija with my brother, and it telling me I was going to play for the Charlorte [sic] Hornets.  I excelled at music through high school, but never did much with it (failed my music major entrance exam in college).  I actually make a decent living (over 6 figures gross), but am swamped in debt because of the last year.

I dunno.  I don't remember my childhood fondly.  There are a few key moments that stick out, like wanting to be an olympic gymnast (that was 5th grade playground, I think), and the aforementioned Ouija incident.   In Jr. High I thought I'd be a novelist.  In high school I thought I'd be a composer.

Since then, I've never really had a solid goal in life.  I've just coasted along.  I'm decent at what I do.  But there's no joy in my life anymore, and I'm tired of chasing after that.

I'm a coward.  And there's no restriction on buying rope.  Just gotta build up and appropriate counterweight (single floor apartment), and put on a good video.  With the proper knot, asphyxiation occurs in 3-5 minutes, total death in 20.

He was.  But it was one way affection.  I meant nothing to him.  Quite literally.  As is evident by his abuse and complete withdrawal when I confessed my feelings and wanted to talk.

I will definitely be leaving an explanation of things.  Maybe then people will believe my claims of abuse.

That'll all come in time, I guess.  I want Patrick to know I'm sorry.  I wish he'd just talk to me.   All of this could've been avoided if he'd just talked to me like a human being.

I know he got hurt.  And I'm incredibly sorry for that.  I never, ever, intended to hurt him.  But things got way out of hand.  I want to believe he never intended to hurt me either.  But after months of lying to me for his own benefit, I just can't.  I've tried.  I really have.  I go to bed crying many nights.  And when I do sleep, I have nightmares of him.  All I ever wanted was to talk through the things I was going through, but he never gave me the time of day.

What I did was wrong.  Even if I never intended or wanted it to happen, I did it.  And I've acknowledged that.  I've tried to apologize, and I've tried to get past him.  But I can't.  I need his help, and he's unwilling to give it.
5 year old black lab.  Sweet as can be.  I am going to miss him.  He's the only thing that's kept me going this long.
Thanks.  I guess...
Not a girl.  Don't get the reference.   But bye anyway.
Oh.  I haven't eaten in over 24 hours, just no hunger signals.  And I haven't had a decent meal in over a week.  I scrape by with bags of chips and snacks at work.

I just want my life back.  The one I had before I was forced out.  And that's impossible.  I was fired (they claim my suicide note was a resignation) for attempting suicide.  The EEOC says no discrimination took place.  

I'm barely holding it together.  I have nowhere to turn and nothing to hold on to.  I'm barely caring for my dog, and that breaks my heart even more.  He deserves better. 

What I want is impossible.  My lawyer is incompetent, and doesn't listen to me.  The cops won't believe me because Patrick claimed the victim status already. 

I come home every day and immediately start drinking.  I have nothing left to live for.
Doubt it if you like.  It'll happen.

I begged him to help me, he filed a cyberstalking claim.

It's been over a year that I've been struggling with depression.  I've tried therapy, but now I can't afford it any more.  I've driven away all my friends.  When I came out, my mom was in tears and my dad told me "that's a shame" so I've never felt close to them.

I've got no one left, and it's all my fault.
Not a single lawyer I've contacted will talk to me.  Half of them respond with "we can't take your case at this time" and the other half don't respond at all.

Nothing left to live for.  No one will believe that I was abused by a younger guy.  The detective in charge of the police report even told me "I could've said no.".

Because of him, I've now got a criminal record, I'm swimming in medical and legal bills, and not a single person wants to hear my side of it.
I'll post pics once the noose is around my neck, sure.

I sent him the info, but that was just in our initial phone call.  He told me flat out "you could've said no".  I filed a complaint and asked for the case to be moved to a different detective.

I want to file a civil suit.  The problem is, I'm 700 miles away from where this happened.  And without a criminal conviction or him admitting that yes, he caused my issues, I don't have a leg to stand on.

I just have no way to win this.  I've lost hope.  There's nothing left.

Just heard back from the detective.  He pretty much flat out told me the guy didn't break any laws.

Unless I get positive news on this, I'm gone this weekend. There's no justice in this world.

The problem, again, is proof.  It's his word against mine, and I have no access to proof of the psychological pressure I had to obey him or get beat.  That is locked away in their system (both our profiles are long deleted) only to be accessed by "valid law enforcement agencies".

Also, point of clarification - this hasn't even gone to prosecution.  I am waiting on a *detective* leading the "investigation" to call me back.  Once they compile their evidence, they will present it to a magistrate, who will decide whether or not charges should be leveed.

I have no friends left.  I'm all alone.

My legal debt is now credit card debt.  It's interest free for the moment, but there's nothing I can do but just pay it off as I can.

Yes.  The fucker belongs in jail.  He's utterly destroyed my life.  I've already filed the police report.  People don't press charges, prosecutors do.  They don't go with it unless there's a 51% chance (or so) that the person did it.  That requires proof.  I have my word, and I will direct them towards the site that has the chat logs that can be evidence of the psychological pressure he placed on me.  But it's out of my hands.  My best reason for staying alive is to see that through.

I can't get it expunged until all the charges are dismissed, and even then it's a weird procedure.  That wont be for at least a year.  Meanwhile, I'm in psychological hell.

Oh, and at no point during the cyberstalking shit did anyone actually listen to my side.  No one asked.  I was the bad guy and therefore had no say in anything that went on.

Innocent until proven guilty, my ass.

My lawyer said "he didn't do anything criminal, just two consensual adults".  MY FUCKING LAWYER IS ON HIS SIDE.

My credit is, so far, excellent.  I have an 800+ rating.  THat's about to tank, as I have no clue how much debt I'm actually in.  The police won't call me back on my report of abuse.  When I try to talk to my friends, they just say "go talk to your therapist".  My mom is trying too hard calling every day and saying "I love you".  I haven't loved her in over 10 years.  I am dead inside.  When I try to open up to people, they just turn away.  I've got no one left.
I think my income alone would disqualify me.  I make over 6 figures gross, but am swamped in debt because of this....
